name: Ahvenanmaan pyhäpäivät ja liputuspäivät – kattava monikielinen (1917–2030)
title: Ahvenanmaan pyhäpäivät ja liputuspäivät – kattava monikielinen (1917–2030)
description: Comprehensive public holidays and flag days for the Finnish subdivision 01 — Ahvenanmaan maakunta (Landskapet Åland) — from 1917 through 2030. Identical to fi-pyhapaivat-completos PLUS the only subdivision-specific Finnish statutory holiday in vacanza: Ahvenanmaan itsehallintopäivä (Åland Autonomy Day, 9 June), celebrated annually since 1993 in recognition of the 1920 Autonomy Act. All three supported_categories included.

meta.title: Ahvenanmaan pyhäpäivät ja liputuspäivät – kattava monikielinen (1917–2030) - Ilmainen lataus
meta.description: Comprehensive public holidays and flag days for the Finnish subdivision 01 — Ahvenanmaan maakunta (Landskapet Åland) — from 1917 through 2030. Identical to fi-pyhapaivat-completos PLUS the only subdivision-specific Finnish statutory holiday in vacanza: Ahvenanmaan itsehallintopäivä (Åland Autonomy Day, 9 June), celebrated annually since 1993 in recognition of the 1920 Autonomy Act. Generated via the _populate_subdiv_01_public_holidays method of vacanza Finland. Multilingual names in all five supported_languages (fi / sv_FI / en_US / th / uk). All three supported_categories included. Sisältää 2888 tietuetta. Lataa Excel, CSV, PDF muodoissa.
